title: Serving Long-Context LLMs at the Mobile Edge: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning-based Model Caching and Inference Offloading
authors: Minrui Xu; Dusit Niyato; Christopher G. Brinton
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, Reasoning / Test-time scaling, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Resource-limited mobile edge networks struggle to support long-context LLM serving for LLM agents during multi-round interactions, because LLMs continuously learn from context (raising accuracy, latency, and resource-consumption dynamics) and can overflow context windows. Existing stateless computation offloading and static service offloading cannot accommodate these dynamics.
problem_statement.zh: 資源受限的 mobile edge 網路難以支援 LLM agent 在多輪互動中的長 context LLM serving：LLM 會持續從 context 中學習（使準確度、延遲與資源消耗具動態性），且可能造成 context window 溢位。現有的無狀態 computation offloading 與靜態 service offloading 無法因應此類動態。

key_innovation.en: A joint model-caching and inference-offloading framework formulated as a mixed-integer/MDP problem, solved by a test-time deep reinforcement learning (T2DRL) algorithm whose actor-critic uses test-time-training models to adapt caching and offloading decisions during execution. It further introduces a Double Dutch Auction (DDA) that dynamically matches edge-server supply with user-device demand, maximizing social welfare while remaining individually rational, incentive-compatible, and budget-balanced.
key_innovation.zh: 提出聯合 model caching 與 inference offloading 的框架，並將其建模為 mixed-integer/MDP 問題；以 test-time deep reinforcement learning (T2DRL) 求解，其 actor-critic 採用 test-time-training 模型，於執行期動態調整 caching 與 offloading 決策。此外導入 Double Dutch Auction (DDA)，動態匹配 edge server 供給與 user device 需求，在維持 individual rationality、incentive compatibility 與 budget balance 的前提下最大化 social welfare。

key_improvements.en: The T2DRL algorithm reduces total system cost by at least 30% versus baselines (and outperforms PPO by about 20% in cost efficiency) while guaranteeing the perception and reasoning performance of LLM agents; the DDA reaches market clearing with strong budget balance and incentive compatibility.
key_improvements.zh: T2DRL 相較 baselines 將總系統成本降低至少 30%（成本效率較 PPO 高約 20%），同時保證 LLM agent 的感知與推理表現；DDA 則在強 budget balance 與 incentive compatibility 下達成市場結清。

node_count: N edge servers + 1 cloud data center (simulated)
